key_findings_summary.baseline_problem: RSI + Bollinger strategy with current logic cannot catch strong trends (0/32); root causes: data format, RSI 50.63 at starts, no crossover, 4h regime
key_findings_summary.trend_capture_solution: secondary entry path that: (a) does NOT require RSI crossover, (b) uses BB basis position + ADX + regime + pullback logic, (c) has anti-FOMO protection, (d) uses separate score threshold, (e) integrates through same safety pipeline
key_findings_summary.expected_impact: trend catch rate should improve from 0/32; if conditions are met for several of the 32 trend starts, catch rate becomes meaningful; profit factor and win rate depend on trade quality of captured trends
key_findings_summary.next_steps: run full backtest integration, analyze results, approve TESTNET activation if all 10 success criteria met
